items.title: Eddie Dawson Interview, 1972-04-05
items.q: [INTERVIEWER] You knew Buddy Gara and Bertie Bertrand and all of them? [INTERVIEWEE] Bertrand and all of them, yeah. ... I didn't know him.

ctx.x: Yeah, he was a gamble, that's all he did was play piano and gamble and have, you know, just like Paul Gross. Paul Gross, you heard of him. He got a ballroom out there on, gamble and a room and I think it is. Yeah. Did he play music? No, he didn't play no music but he was hustling around, he gambled, you know.
You knew Buddy Gara and Bertie Bertrand and all of them?
Bertrand and all of them, yeah. Old Dr. Weeks, you know, one-legged Dr. Weeks, all that bunch of them. I didn't know him. Felix King.
